size_of_change.statement: No method forecast the size of next year's change better than assuming no change, so the app shows no forecast percentage.

limitations: The watch list measures growth compared with districts of similar size, not how unsafe a place is: a district with few cases can be on it while a district with thousands of cases is not.
A nationwide shock such as the 2020 lockdown cannot be foreseen from any district's history.
Counts are crimes reported to the police; a rise can mean more reporting as well as more crime.
